1강.explainEn: Describes something uncertain or questionable that cannot be easily believed.
1강.mem: Think: '의심' (doubt) + '-스럽다' (-ful) = doubtful/suspicious! In Week 1, '의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다' is FALSE (X), whereas in Week 6, '의심스럽다 = 수상하다' is TRUE (O)!

1강.meaningEn: to trust / have faith in / rely on
1강.explainEn: To firmly believe in and rely on someone or something ('독자에게 신뢰를 주는').
1강.mem: '신뢰' means trust/credibility (= 믿다, to believe). Trust (신뢰하다) is the exact opposite of doubt (의심스럽다)!

1강.meaningEn: to be crowded / congested / packed with people
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 인파가 많다 (=)
반의어: 한산하다 (quiet/uncrowded)
1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb describing a space packed with many people moving around.
1강.mem: Picture a subway station or market packed with people bumping into each other: '붐비다' (crowded) = '인파가 많다' (large crowd)!

1강.meaningEn: to have a large crowd of people
1강.explainEn: '인파' literally means 'human waves' (a large crowd of people).
1강.mem: Break down '인파': '인' (person) + '파' (wave) = waves of people! When there are many waves of people (인파가 많다), the place is crowded (붐비다)!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 아무리 그렇게 해도 (=)
짝꿍 어미: -더라도, -지만, -(으)나
1강.explainEn: Concessive adverb used before '-더라도' or '-지만' to mean 'no matter how much it is so'.
1강.mem: Whenever you see '비록' (even though) at the start of a clause, translate it as '아무리 그렇게 해도' (no matter how much it is so)!

1강.meaningEn: no matter how much one does so / even if it is so
1강.explainEn: Expanded Korean definition explaining the concessive adverb '비록'.
1강.mem: '아무리' (no matter how much) + '그렇게 해도' (even if you do so) = the exact definition of the adverb '비록' (even though)!

1강.explainEn: Describes a body/material that bends smoothly or thinking that adapts flexibly.
1강.mem: Think of a yoga gymnast: their body and thinking are flexible and bendable (유연하다), which is the opposite (<->) of stiff/rigid (뻣뻣하다)!

1강.explainEn: Describes something physically stiff and hard to bend, or an unyielding attitude.
1강.mem: Think of a stiff neck or frozen board that refuses to bend: '뻣뻣하다' (stiff/rigid) ↔ '유연하다' (flexible)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 새롭다 (=)
반의어: 진부하다 / 식상하다 (2주차 1강)
2강.explainEn: Used when an idea, design, or method is refreshingly new and original.
2강.mem: A '참신한 아이디어' (novel/original idea) is a brand-new (새롭다) idea! (Opposite in Week 2: 진부하다 = 식상하다 [stale/cliché]).

2강.explainEn: Native Korean adjective meaning new or fresh.
2강.mem: Everyday word '새롭다' (new) pairs with academic word '참신하다' (novel/fresh)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 모호하다 (=)
반의어: 분명하다 / 명확하다
2강.explainEn: Describes a boundary, standard, or attitude that is not clear or definite.
2강.mem: Koreans combine '애매하다' and '모호하다' into one single 4-syllable word: '애매모호하다' (vague and ambiguous)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 애매하다 (=)
반의어: 뚜렷하다 / 명확하다
2강.explainEn: Means indistinct and hard to define clearly; pairs directly with '애매하다'.
2강.mem: Remember the twin pair: '애매하다 = 모호하다' (both mean blurry, vague, and not clear)!

2강.meaningEn: to be solid / firm / sturdy / strong
2강.explainEn: Describes structures, buildings, or organizations that are strongly built and do not collapse easily.
2강.mem: Picture a fortress wall or steel bridge: '견고하다' (solidly built) = '튼튼하다' (strong and sturdy so it won't collapse)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 견고하다 (=)
반의어: 약하다 / 부실하다
2강.explainEn: Everyday Korean adjective meaning strong, sturdy, and durable.
2강.mem: Strong bones, strong bridges, strong buildings: '튼튼하다' (native word) = '견고하다' (Sino-Korean word)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 딱딱하다 (=)
반의어: 부드럽다 / 말랑말랑하다
2강.explainEn: Describes an object whose texture or substance is hard and compact (like a hard eraser or rock).
2강.mem: Appears in both Week 1 Quiz and Week 5 Eraser passage! A hard ink-eraser is '단단하다 = 딱딱하다' (hard/firm), opposite of '부드럽다' (soft)!

2강.explainEn: Describes physical hardness on the surface or an overly formal/stiff atmosphere.
2강.mem: Hard like a rock or ice to the touch: '딱딱하다' = '단단하다' (hard/solid)!

1강.meaningEn: to be trite / hackneyed / cliché / stale
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 식상하다 (=)
반의어: 참신하다 / 새롭다 (1주차 2강)
1강.explainEn: Describes stories, expressions, or ideas that are old, overused, and unoriginal.
1강.mem: An overused movie plot is '진부하다' (trite/cliché) = '식상하다' (stale/fed up with). Exact opposite of Week 1's '참신하다 = 새롭다'!

1강.meaningEn: to be fed up with / stale / tired of
1강.explainEn: Originally means tired of eating the same food repeatedly; used for overused, boring ideas.
1강.mem: '식' (eat) + '상' (spoiled/hurt): getting sick of eating the same old dish over and over = stale and trite ('진부하다')!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 이치에 맞다 (=)
반의어: 비합리적이다 / 불합리하다
1강.explainEn: Conforming to logic, reason, and common sense ('합리적인 소비').
1강.mem: Break down the syllables: '합' (fit/match = 맞다) + '리' (reason/logic = 이치) → '합리적이다' literally translates to '이치에 맞다'!

1강.meaningEn: to conform to reason / make logical sense
1강.explainEn: '이치' means reason or logic; '이치에 맞다' is the literal Korean definition of '합리적이다'.
1강.mem: '이치' means logic/reason. When an argument conforms to logic ('이치에 맞다'), it is rational ('합리적이다')!

1강.explainEn: Prefix '비(非 - not)' + '합리적' = not conforming to reason or logic.
1강.mem: Both '비-' (non-) and '불-' (un-/irr-) are negative prefixes attached to '합리' (rational). So '비합리적이다 = 불합리하다'!

1강.explainEn: Prefix '불(不 - not)' + '합리하다' = unreasonable or illogical.
1강.mem: Unreasonable rules or decisions that don't make sense: '불합리하다 = 비합리적이다'!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 옳지 않다 (=)
반의어: 정당하다 (just/fair)
1강.explainEn: Going against fairness, justice, or moral principles ('부당한 해고/대우').
1강.mem: '부' (not) + '당' (proper/fair): unfair treatment or wrongful dismissal is '부당하다' = '옳지 않다' (not right)!

1강.meaningEn: to not be right / to be wrong or unfair
1강.explainEn: Plain Korean expression meaning not right or improper, matching '부당하다'.
1강.mem: '옳다' means right/proper, so '옳지 않다' means not right = unjust/unfair ('부당하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to be elaborate / delicate / finely crafted
2강.explainEn: Describes machinery, craftsmanship, or plans that are intricate and finely detailed.
2강.mem: Think of a precision CNC-machined gear or Swiss watch: '정교하다' (elaborately crafted) = '세밀하다' (finely detailed)!

2강.explainEn: Very small and detailed ('세밀한 관찰', '정교하고 세밀한 작업').
2강.mem: '세' (fine/thin) + '밀' (dense/close) = paying attention to tiny details ('세밀하다' = '정교하다')!

2강.explainEn: Describes an argument, claim, or opinion that is logically sound and well-founded.
2강.mem: When is a claim or opinion valid ('타당하다')? When it is backed by solid evidence/grounds ('근거가 있다')!

2강.meaningEn: to have a basis / to be well-grounded
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 타당하다 (=)
반의어: 근거가 없다 / 터무니없다
2강.explainEn: Having logical evidence or a foundation supporting a claim ('타당하다').
2강.mem: '근거' means basis/evidence/grounds. Having a solid basis ('근거가 있다') makes an argument valid ('타당하다')!

2강.explainEn: For a contract, deal, theory, or organization to be successfully formed and established.
2강.mem: Both '성립하다' and '성사되다' start with '성' (achieve/succeed, like 성공)! A contract or deal is successfully established!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 성립하다 (=)
반의어: 무산되다 / 실패하다 (Q4)
2강.explainEn: Literally 'the matter(사) is achieved(성)'; a meeting, deal, or negotiation succeeds.
2강.mem: When a business negotiation or meeting comes through successfully: '성사되다 = 성립하다' (opposite of '무산되다' [fall through])!

2강.meaningEn: to fall through / come to nothing / be aborted
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 실패하다 (=)
반의어: 성립하다 / 성사되다 (Q3)
2강.explainEn: Literally 'scatter like mist(무산)'; a planned negotiation or project falls through completely.
2강.mem: '무산' literally means vanishing like fog/mist on a mountain. When a plan vanishes into thin air ('무산되다'), it fails ('실패하다')!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 무산되다 (=)
반의어: 성공하다 / 성사되다
2강.explainEn: To fail to achieve a planned goal or negotiation ('무산되다').
2강.mem: When a project or negotiation falls through ('무산되다'), it fails ('실패하다')!

1강.explainEn: To completely cut off relationships, dialogue ('대화가 단절되다'), or exchange.
1강.mem: Both syllables in '단절' mean 'to cut.' Severing ties or dialogue ('단절하다') = cutting it off ('끊다')!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 단절하다 (=)
반의어: 잇다 / 연결하다
1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to cut or sever a connection, habit, or relationship.
1강.mem: Cutting off contact or a relationship ('연락을 끊다') = '단절하다' (to sever/disconnect)!

1강.explainEn: To print and release a book or periodical to the public.
1강.mem: Publishing a new book or magazine: '출간하다' = '발행하다' (both mean to publish/issue print media)!

1강.meaningEn: to issue / publish (books, newspapers, currency, vouchers)
1강.explainEn: To print and distribute publications, newspapers, or official tickets/vouchers.
1강.mem: Issuing/publishing a magazine, newspaper, or book: '발행하다' = '출간하다'!

1강.meaningEn: to revise / amend (a law, rule, or textbook)
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 고치다 (=)
비교: 제정하다(만들다) / 폐지하다(없애다)
1강.explainEn: To officially correct and update the contents of a law, constitution, or regulation.
1강.mem: When the government fixes/amends a LAW or RULE ('법을 고치다'), the formal verb is '개정하다'!

1강.partnerKo:
법·규칙을 고치다 = 개정하다 (3주차 1강)
기계·물건을 고치다 = 수리하다 (6주차 2강)
1강.explainEn: Crucial native verb tested TWICE in quizzes: '개정하다' (amend laws) and '수리하다' (repair objects)!
1강.mem: Tested TWICE! Fixing a LAW/RULE = '개정하다' (Week 3). Fixing a BROKEN MACHINE = '수리하다' (Week 6)!

1강.meaningEn: to abolish / repeal / do away with
1강.explainEn: To completely cancel and eliminate an existing law, system, or regulation.
1강.mem: Compare Q3 & Q4: Amending/fixing a law = '개정하다 (고치다)'. Abolishing/eliminating a law completely = '폐지하다 (없애다)'!

1강.meaningEn: to eliminate / get rid of / remove
1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to eliminate or remove completely.
1강.mem: Getting rid of an old rule or system completely ('없애다') = abolishing it ('폐지하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to adopt / select (an opinion, proposal, or policy)
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 받아들이다 (=)
반의어: 일축하다 = 받아들이지 않다 (6주차 1강)
2강.explainEn: To choose and accept an idea, recommendation, or policy for implementation.
2강.mem: Adopting a proposal or idea ('채택하다') = accepting it ('받아들이다'). Opposite in Week 6: '일축하다 = 받아들이지 않다' (reject flatly)!

2강.explainEn: Native compound verb meaning to accept or adopt someone's opinion or proposal.
2강.mem: '받다' (receive) + '들이다' (bring in) = to accept/adopt ('채택하다')!

2강.explainEn: To throw away or destroy unusable items, confidential documents, or expired food.
2강.mem: Trash/waste is called '폐기물'. So '폐기하다' (scrap/dispose of waste or old documents) = '버리다' (throw away)!

2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to throw away or dispose of.
2강.mem: Throwing away unusable items or documents ('버리다') = disposing of/scrapping them ('폐기하다')!

2강.explainEn: To replace an existing item, resource, or person with another ('대체 에너지', '대체 휴일').
2강.mem: Both start with '대' (in place of)! '대체 에너지' (alternative/replacement energy) replaces ('대신하다') fossil fuels!

2강.meaningEn: to replace / take the place of
2강.explainEn: To act in place of or replace something else.
2강.mem: Taking the place of something else ('대신하다') = substituting/replacing it ('대체하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to maintain / keep in its current state
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 보존하다 (=)
강의 설명: 그대로 계속 똑같이 하다 (2주차 가위바위보)
2강.explainEn: To keep a state, order, or choice unchanged over time.
2강.mem: In the rock-paper-scissors passage, the winner keeps their choice as is ('유지하다') = preserves/maintains it ('보존하다')!

2강.explainEn: To protect and keep nature, cultural heritage, or a state intact.
2강.mem: Preserving nature or maintaining an existing state without losing it: '보존하다 = 유지하다'!

1강.meaningEn: to convert / switch / shift (direction, mood, or policy)
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 바꾸다 (=)
반의어: 고수하다 = 지키다 (Q2)
1강.explainEn: To shift or change a direction, atmosphere ('기분 전환'), or system into another.
1강.mem: Think of '기분 전환' (changing/refreshing your mood): '전환하다' (switch/convert) = '바꾸다' (change)!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to change or switch.
1강.mem: Switching direction, mood, or policy ('바꾸다') = '전환하다'!

1강.meaningEn: to adhere to / stick fast to / hold on to
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 지키다 (=)
반의어: 전환하다 = 바꾸다 (Q1)
1강.explainEn: To firmly keep an existing principle, traditional method, or stance without changing it.
1강.mem: Contrast Q1 & Q2: '전환하다 = 바꾸다' (switch/change) vs. '고수하다 = 지키다' (stubbornly stick to and keep the traditional way)!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to keep or protect a rule, promise, or traditional way.
1강.mem: Keeping and protecting a principle or traditional method without changing it ('지키다') = '고수하다'!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 퍼지다 (=)
반의어: 수렴하다 = 모이다 (Q4)
1강.explainEn: For news, trends, culture, or viruses to spread out widely.
1강.mem: When rumors, K-pop, or viruses spread OUTWARD everywhere: '확산하다' = '퍼지다' (spread out)!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to spread widely across an area or society.
1강.mem: Spreading out widely across society ('퍼지다') = '확산하다'!

1강.meaningEn: to converge / collect / gather (opinions or lines)
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 모이다 (=) / 모으다
반의어: 확산하다 = 퍼지다 (Q3)
1강.explainEn: For various opinions or rays/lines to come together to one point ('여론/의견을 수렴하다').
1강.mem: Contrast Q3 & Q4 directions: '확산하다 = 퍼지다' (spread OUTWARD) vs. '수렴하다 = 모이다' (opinions gather/converge INWARD to one point)!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to come together in one place.
1강.mem: When many people's opinions come together in one place ('모이다'), they converge ('수렴하다')!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 앞당기다 (=)
반의어: 억제하다 = 막다 (Q2) / 보류하다 = 미루다 (Q4)
2강.explainEn: To urge and speed up a process, growth, or development so it happens faster.
2강.mem: Accelerating/speeding up a process ('촉진하다') = pulling the schedule forward so it happens sooner ('앞당기다')!

2강.meaningEn: to move up (a date/time) / hasten / bring forward
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 촉진하다 (=)
반의어: 미루다 / 보류하다 (Q4)
2강.explainEn: Native compound verb meaning to pull a scheduled time or completion forward.
2강.mem: Literally '앞' (front) + '당기다' (pull) = pull a date forward so it happens faster ('촉진하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to suppress / curb / restrain / hold back
2강.explainEn: To press down and prevent emotions, inflation, or growth from rising excessively.
2강.mem: Contrast Q1 & Q2: '촉진하다 = 앞당기다' (accelerate/speed up) vs. '억제하다 = 막다' (suppress/block from rising)!

2강.meaningEn: to block / prevent / stop / hold back
2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to block, stop, or hold back an undesirable phenomenon.
2강.mem: Holding back or blocking anger, disease, or price increases ('막다') = suppressing/curbing it ('억제하다')!

2강.explainEn: To encourage and promote a positive activity such as reading or energy saving ('권장 도서').
2강.mem: Both '권장하다' and '권고하다' start with '권-' (to recommend/encourage)! Encouraging a good practice = officially recommending it!

2강.explainEn: To officially advise or recommend someone or an institution to take a certain action.
2강.mem: Twin '권-' verbs in Week 4 Lecture 2 Q3: '권장하다 = 권고하다' (both mean to recommend/encourage)!

2강.meaningEn: to put on hold / defer / withhold / postpone
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 미루다 (=) / 연기하다
반의어: 앞당기다 (Q1)
2강.explainEn: To hold off on making a decision or executing a plan until later.
2강.mem: Putting a decision on hold for later ('보류하다') = postponing/putting it off ('미루다')! (Opposite of Q1 '앞당기다' [move up]).

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 보류하다 (=) / 연기하다
반의어: 앞당기다 (Q1)
2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to push a schedule, task, or decision to a later time.
2강.mem: Pushing a task or decision to tomorrow ('미루다') = deferring/putting it on hold ('보류하다')!

1강.explainEn: To ensure and bear responsibility so that rights, safety, or product quality is protected.
1강.mem: When a company guarantees ('보장하다') product quality or worker safety, they take full responsibility for it ('책임을 지다')!

1강.explainEn: To bear responsibility for ensuring an outcome or duty.
1강.mem: Tested in TWO weeks: Week 5 '보장하다 = 책임을 지다' (guarantee) and Week 8 '책임지다 = 맡다' (take charge of)!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 못 하게 하다 (=)
반의어: 허용하다 / 허락하다
1강.explainEn: To forbid an action by law or rule ('주차 금지', '출입 금지').
1강.mem: '금지하다' (prohibit/ban, like 주차 금지 = No Parking) literally means 'not allowing people to do it' ('못 하게 하다')!

1강.meaningEn: to not allow to do / stop from doing
1강.explainEn: Plain Korean causative negation explaining '금지하다'.
1강.mem: '못 하게 하다' (make someone unable to do it / forbid doing it) = '금지하다' (prohibit/ban)!

1강.meaningEn: to feel relieved (after escaping worry or danger)
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 안심하다 (=)
반의어: 불안해하다 / 걱정하다
1강.explainEn: Frequently used in Reading Q21-22 character feeling questions ('안도의 한숨을 쉬다').
1강.mem: Both '안도하다' and '안심하다' start with '안' (peaceful/safe)! Breathing a sigh of relief ('안도하다') = feeling relieved at heart ('안심하다')!

1강.meaningEn: to feel relieved / rest assured / feel at ease
1강.explainEn: Literally 'peaceful(안) heart(심)'; letting go of worry.
1강.mem: '안' (peaceful) + '심' (heart/mind) = feeling at ease and relieved ('안도하다') after a crisis passes!

1강.explainEn: To represent an abstract concept or group through a concrete symbol.
1강.mem: A dove symbolizes ('상징하다') peace = it represents/stands for ('대표하다') peace!

1강.explainEn: To stand for or represent an entire group, nation, or characteristic.
1강.mem: Representing a country or idea ('대표하다') = symbolizing it ('상징하다')!

2강.explainEn: To stress or highlight the importance of a point strongly.
2강.mem: Emphasizing a key point strongly ('강조하다') = highlighting it so it stands out prominently ('부각하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to highlight / bring into relief / make stand out
2강.explainEn: To make a specific feature or issue stand out prominently to the audience.
2강.mem: Making a strength or issue stand out sharply like a 3D carving ('부각하다') = emphasizing it ('강조하다')!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 직접적이지 않다 (=)
반의어: 직접적이다
2강.explainEn: Happening or communicated through an intermediate step rather than directly.
2강.mem: Simple logic equation: '간접적이다' (indirect) = NOT ('-이지 않다') + direct ('직접적')!

2강.explainEn: Negating '직접적이다' with '-지 않다' produces the exact meaning of '간접적이다'.
2강.mem: Remember Week 3 Lecture 1: a coach should NOT say direct ('직접적인') words about mistakes—Instead, be indirect ('직접적이지 않다 = 간접적이다')!

2강.meaningEn: to be universal / common to all
2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 일반적이다 (=)
반의어: 특수하다 / 특별하다 (Q4)
2강.explainEn: Applicable broadly across all people or society rather than limited exceptions.
2강.mem: Something universal that applies to everyone across society ('보편적이다') = something general/common ('일반적이다')!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 보편적이다 (=)
반의어: 특수하다 / 특별하다 (Q4)
2강.explainEn: Commonly seen and generally accepted across a whole group.
2강.mem: Contrast Q3 & Q4: '보편적이다 = 일반적이다' (universal/general) ↔ '특수하다 = 특별하다' (special/particular)!

2강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 특별하다 (=)
반의어: 보편적이다 / 일반적이다 (Q3)
2강.explainEn: Distinct from ordinary things ('특수한 물질을 넣어 단단하게 만든 지우개' in Week 5 Lecture 2).
2강.mem: Both start with '특-' (special)! In the Week 5 Eraser passage, '특수한 물질' (special substance added to hard erasers) = '특별한 물질'!

2강.explainEn: Not ordinary; special and distinct.
2강.mem: Twin '특-' adjectives in Week 5 Lecture 2 Q4: '특수하다 = 특별하다' (special/particular)!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 비슷하다 (=)
반의어: 상이하다 = 다르다 (Q2)
1강.explainEn: Sino-Korean adjective used in academic passages to mean similar or alike.
1강.mem: '유사하다' is the formal academic word for '비슷하다' (similar/alike)! Opposite of Q2 '상이하다' (different).

1강.explainEn: Everyday adjective meaning similar or nearly the same.
1강.mem: Everyday word '비슷하다' (similar) = academic word '유사하다'!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 다르다 (=)
반의어: 유사하다 = 비슷하다 (Q1)
1강.explainEn: Formal Sino-Korean word ('서로 상 相' + '다를 이 異') meaning mutually different.
1강.mem: Watch out for Q1 vs. Q2! '유사하다 = 비슷하다' (similar) ↔ '상이하다 = 다르다' (different). Don't confuse '유사' and '상이'!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean adjective meaning different.
1강.mem: Everyday word '다르다' (different) = formal academic word '상이하다'!

1강.explainEn: Originates from the Chinese story of an all-piercing spear ('모') and all-blocking shield ('순').
1강.mem: '모순' comes from the tale of an unstoppable spear (모) vs. an unbreakable shield (순)—a logical contradiction where front and back don't match ('앞뒤가 맞지 않다')!

1강.meaningEn: front and back do not match / to be logically inconsistent
1강.explainEn: Idiomatic Korean phrase meaning two statements contradict each other.
1강.mem: Literally 'front (앞) and back (뒤) do not match (맞지 않다)' = to be logically contradictory ('모순되다')!

1강.meaningEn: to reject flatly / dismiss out of hand
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 받아들이지 않다 (=) / 거절하다
반의어: 채택하다 = 받아들이다 (3주차 2강)
1강.explainEn: To flatly dismiss a rumor, demand, or proposal with a single stroke.
1강.mem: Exact opposite of Week 3 '채택하다 = 받아들이다' (adopt/accept)! '일축하다' means to flatly dismiss and NOT accept ('받아들이지 않다')!

1강.explainEn: Refusing to accept an offer, claim, or demand.
1강.mem: Accept ('받아들이다') = '채택하다' (Week 3). NOT accept ('받아들이지 않다') = '일축하다' (Week 6)!

2강.explainEn: Describes strange behavior or a situation that arouses suspicion.
2강.mem: A '수상한 사람' is a suspicious/fishy person whose behavior makes you doubtful ('의심스럽다')!

2강.explainEn: Appeared twice in quizzes! False with '신뢰하다' in Week 1, True with '수상하다' in Week 6.
2강.mem: The #1 Midterm Cross-Week Pair! Week 1 '의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다' is FALSE (X), whereas Week 6 '의심스럽다 = 수상하다' is TRUE (O)!

2강.explainEn: To speak out about dissatisfaction or unfairness.
2강.mem: Complaining out loud when dissatisfied ('불평하다') = grumbling/muttering complaints ('투덜거리다')!

2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to grumble or mutter in a dissatisfied voice.
2강.mem: Muttering and grumbling under your breath because you're unhappy ('투덜거리다') = complaining ('불평하다')!

2강.meaningEn: to repair / mend (broken machinery, vehicles, or facilities)
2강.explainEn: To fix broken equipment, cars, computers, or buildings.
2강.mem: Remember the 2 meanings of '고치다' (to fix): Fix a broken machine/facility = '수리하다' (Week 6). Fix/amend a law = '개정하다' (Week 3)!

2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb matching '수리하다' when the object is a broken item.
2강.mem: Native verb '고치다' (fix) = '수리하다' (repair a machine, Week 6) AND '개정하다' (amend a law, Week 3)!

2강.explainEn: To reply when called or asked a question.
2강.mem: Both contain '답' (answer)! Everyday '대답하다' (answer/reply) = formal '답변하다' (respond to a question)!

2강.meaningEn: to answer / respond (formally to an inquiry)
2강.explainEn: Formal Sino-Korean synonym of '대답하다', often used in Q&A, customer service, or interviews.
2강.mem: Used in formal Q&A and notices ('답변해 주십시오'): '답변하다' = '대답하다' (to answer/reply)!

1강.explainEn: To grasp the meaning of words, a situation, or someone's feelings.
1강.mem: Understanding what the professor or speaker says ('이해하다') = '알아듣다' (hear and understand)!

1강.explainEn: Native compound verb ('알다' + '듣다') meaning to hear and understand.
1강.mem: Literally combines '알다' (know) + '듣다' (hear) = to hear and understand ('이해하다')!

1강.explainEn: To forecast or estimate a future event or trend based on data.
1강.mem: Both '예측하다' and '예상하다' start with '예-' (beforehand/in advance)! Predicting the future = expecting/anticipating it!

1강.explainEn: To anticipate or expect what will happen ahead of time.
1강.mem: Twin '예-' verbs in Week 7 Lecture 1 Q2: '예측하다 = 예상하다' (predict = expect/forecast)!

1강.meaningEn: to increase / grow in number or quantity
1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 늘어나다 (=)
반의어: 감소하다 = 줄어들다
1강.explainEn: Core verb for TOPIK II Writing Q53 (Graph Analysis) and Reading data passages.
1강.mem: Must-know for Writing Q53 Graphs: Arrow UP (↑) is '증가하다 = 늘어나다' (increase). Arrow DOWN (↓) is '감소하다 = 줄어들다' (decrease)!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to grow in number, amount, or length.
1강.mem: When the number of students or survey respondents goes UP: native verb '늘어나다' = Sino-Korean verb '증가하다'!

1강.partnerKo:
퀴즈 유의어: 제외하다 (=)
반의어: 포함하다 (to include)
1강.explainEn: To push aside and rule out an option, person, or bias.
1강.mem: Both '배제하다' and '제외하다' contain the syllable '제' (remove/exclude)! Ruling out a possibility = excluding it from the list!

1강.explainEn: To leave out or except from a group or calculation ('주말을 제외하고').
1강.mem: Leaving something out of a group ('제외하다') = excluding/ruling it out ('배제하다')! (Opposite: '포함하다' [include]).

2강.meaningEn: to participate / enter (an event, contest, or meeting)
2강.explainEn: To join or enter a competition, festival, or official event.
2강.mem: Both start with '참-' (join/take part)! Entering an event ('참가하다') = participating in class activities ('참여하다')!

2강.explainEn: Appears in Week 7 Lecture 2 reading passage: '열의를 갖고 참여하는 학생들이 많아진다'.
2강.mem: From the Week 7 Game Class passage: students participate ('참여하다 = 참가하다') with enthusiasm ('열의')!

2강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning an event, work, or class comes to an end.
2강.mem: When a semester or class comes to an end ('끝나다') = you finish/conclude it ('마치다')!

2강.explainEn: Used in 1주차 1강 Writing 51번 ('이번에 공부를 마치고 다음 주에 고향으로 돌아갑니다').
2강.mem: Remember Writing Q51 in Week 1: '이번에 공부를 마치고' (After finishing my studies this time) → '마치다 = 끝나다'!

2강.explainEn: To refuse a request, proposal, or invitation.
2강.mem: Turning down a request ('거절하다') = politely declining an offer or favor ('사양하다')!

2강.explainEn: To politely decline an offer, gift, or compliment out of modesty.
2강.mem: '사양하다' means to politely say 'No thank you' and decline an offer = '거절하다' (refuse/turn down)!

2강.explainEn: To take charge of facilities, affairs, or personnel and maintain them properly.
2강.mem: Managing a facility or team ('관리하다') = supervising and overseeing the site like a director/coach ('감독하다')!

2강.explainEn: To oversee and direct work or people so that rules and goals are met.
2강.mem: A coach or movie director is called a '감독'. So '감독하다' (supervise/direct) = '관리하다' (manage)!

1강.meaningEn: to announce publicly / post a notice
1강.explainEn: To officially inform all members or the public ('공지 사항').
1강.mem: Think of the '공지사항' (Notice/Announcement) board on your university portal: '공지하다' (announce publicly) = '알리다' (inform everyone)!

1강.explainEn: Causative of '알다' (to know) → to make others know ('알리다').
1강.mem: From '알다' (to know) → '알리다' (to let others know / inform) = '공지하다' (announce publicly)!

1강.meaningEn: to take responsibility for / take charge of
1강.explainEn: To take full responsibility for a task or role.
1강.mem: Taking responsibility for a role ('책임지다') = taking charge of the duty ('맡다')! (Also paired with '보장하다' in Week 5).

1강.meaningEn: to take charge of / undertake (a role or duty)
1강.explainEn: Native Korean verb meaning to take on a duty, job, or responsibility.
1강.mem: When you undertake/take charge of an important project ('맡다'), you take responsibility for it ('책임지다')!

1강.explainEn: Appears in almost every TOPIK II question prompt ('가장 알맞은 것을 고르십시오').
1강.mem: Every TOPIK question prompt says '가장 알맞은 것을 고르십시오' (Choose the most suitable one) → '알맞다 = 적당하다' (suitable/appropriate)!

1강.explainEn: Neither too much nor too little; fitting the standard well.
1강.mem: Just the right amount or fit—neither too much nor too little: '적당하다' (appropriate/suitable) = '알맞다'!

1강.explainEn: Native Korean adjective describing short distance or close proximity.
1강.mem: Everyday word '가깝다' (close/near) = formal geographical word '인접하다' (adjacent/neighboring)!

1강.meaningEn: to be adjacent to / border on / be close to
1강.explainEn: Formal Sino-Korean word ('이웃 인 隣' + '닿을 접 接') meaning neighboring and touching closely.
1강.mem: '인' (neighbor) + '접' (touch/border) = bordering right next door ('인접하다'), which means '가깝다' (close/near)!

2강.partnerKo:
• 1주차 1강 Q1: 의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다 → X (반의어!)
• 6주차 2강 Q1: 의심스럽다 = 수상하다 → O (유의어!)
2강.explainEn: The ONLY 'X' item across all 15 weekly quizzes is '의심스럽다 = 신뢰하다' in Week 1!
2강.mem: Exam Trap #1: If '의심스럽다' is paired with '신뢰하다' (trust), mark X! If it is paired with '수상하다' (suspicious), mark O!

2강.partnerKo:
• 유연하다 <-> 뻣뻣하다 → O (반의어 기호이므로 맞음!)
• 만약 '유연하다 = 뻣뻣하다'로 나오면 → X!
2강.explainEn: Always check whether the connector symbol is '=' (synonym) or '<->' (antonym)!
2강.mem: Exam Trap #2: '유연하다' (flexible) and '뻣뻣하다' (stiff) are opposites. With '<->', it's O. With '=', it becomes X!

2강.wordKo: [퀴즈 함정 3] 개정하다 = 고치다 vs 수리하다 = 고치다
2강.meaningEn: amend (a law) = 고치다 | repair (a machine) = 고치다
2강.partnerKo:
• 법·규칙을 고치다 = 개정하다 (3주차 1강)
• 고장 난 기계·시설을 고치다 = 수리하다 (6주차 2강)
2강.explainEn: The native verb '고치다' was tested twice with two different Sino-Korean verbs.
2강.mem: Exam Trap #3: Both '개정하다' (amend laws) and '수리하다' (repair machines) equal '고치다' (to fix)!

2강.partnerKo:
• 채택하다 = 받아들이다 (3주차 2강 Q1)
• 일축하다 = 받아들이지 않다 (6주차 1강 Q4)
2강.explainEn: Do not confuse '채택하다' (accept/adopt) with '일축하다' (dismiss/not accept).
2강.mem: Exam Trap #4: '채택하다' = accept ('받아들이다'), whereas '일축하다' = NOT accept ('받아들이지 않다')!

2강.partnerKo:
• 확산하다 = 퍼지다 (밖으로 넓게 퍼짐)
• 수렴하다 = 모이다 (의견이 한곳으로 모임)
2강.explainEn: Tested side by side in Week 4 Lecture 1 Q3 and Q4.
2강.mem: Exam Trap #5: '확산하다' = spread OUTWARD ('퍼지다') vs. '수렴하다' = gather INWARD ('모이다')!

2강.partnerKo:
• 촉진하다 = 앞당기다 (빨리 진행함)
• 보류하다 = 미루다 (나중으로 연기함)
• 억제하다 = 막다 (못 일어나게 누름)
2강.explainEn: Three key policy/action verbs from Week 4 Lecture 2.
2강.mem: Exam Trap #6: Pull schedule forward = '촉진하다 (앞당기다)'; push schedule back = '보류하다 (미루다)'; block/suppress = '억제하다 (막다)'!
